hub.title: Analysis

error.title: Couldn't load the analysis
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

inactive.title: Pregnancy isn't set up yet
inactive.body: Add your pregnancy dates first to see your weight, blood pressure and baby movement trends.

hub.footnote: These trends are for tracking, not a medical diagnosis. Bring any concern to your doctor or midwife.

missing.baseline: We don't have your pre-pregnancy weight. Add your weight in your profile or daily log to see your gain.
missing.height: Add your height in your profile to work out your BMI and recommended range.
missing.weights: You haven't logged a weight during pregnancy yet. Log one and the trend shows here.

bp.title: Blood pressure
bp.below: All readings under {sys}/{dia} (the pregnancy blood pressure threshold, ACOG)
bp.high: {n} readings were {sys}/{dia} or higher. This isn't a diagnosis — talk to your doctor or midwife.
bp.severe: A reading of {sys}/{dia} or more was logged. Call your doctor or midwife today.
bp.empty: No blood pressure logged yet. If you have a monitor, add readings from the daily log.

glucose.title: Blood sugar (gestational diabetes)
glucose.above: Talk to your doctor about an average above target.
glucose.empty: No blood sugar logged yet. If your doctor asked you to check it, add readings from the daily log.
glucose.label: {slot}: average {avg}, target under {target} mg/dL

kicks.title: Baby movements
kicks.caption: Minutes to reach {n} movements
kicks.notAll: Some days took over {h} hours or had fewer than {n} movements. If movements slow down, call your doctor or midwife.
kicks.empty: Kick counting usually starts around week {week}. No count logged in the last 7 days.
kicks.chart: Minutes to {n} movements over the last 7 days: {list}

symptoms.title: Symptoms by trimester
symptoms.empty: The symptoms you log are grouped by trimester here.

visits.title: Visits and tests
visits.empty: No visits yet. Add them from your pregnancy calendar.

weight.title: Pregnancy weight gain
weight.chart: Weight gain by week {week}: {gain} kg; recommended range this week {min}–{max} kg

baseline.before_pregnancy: Starting weight {w} kg, your last weight logged before pregnancy.
baseline.first_trimester: Starting weight {w} kg, your first first-trimester weight (an estimate).
baseline.profile: Starting weight {w} kg, from your profile (an estimate).

weight.footnote: Ranges are for a singleton pregnancy (IOM 2009). Tell your doctor about any sudden gain or loss, especially with swelling of the face and hands.
